name: Soybean
thai: ถั่วเหลือง
notes: Choose a variety suited to local day length. Check that water can drain away.

name: Groundnut
notes: Needs well-drained ground. Avoid fields where water collects.

name: Maize
thai: ข้าวโพดเลี้ยงสัตว์
notes: Keep a water backup for flowering. This guide is for grain maize, not sweet corn.

name: Strawberry
thai: สตรอว์เบอร์รี
notes: Needs mild weather; FAO notes tropical production succeeds above 1,000 m. This reference weather point is lower. Check your exact farm elevation, variety, chilling needs, drainage, and irrigation. The water guide is a rough duration-scaled annual range, not a local field recommendation.

name: Arabica coffee
thai: กาแฟอาราบิก้า
notes: A long-term tree crop, not a one-season harvest. Site, variety, shade, soil, water through establishment, flowering, and processing access matter. FAO guidance prefers elevations above 1,000 m; this reference point is lower. The water guide is a rough duration-scaled annual range, not a local field recommendation.

name: Rubber tree
notes: A long-term tree plantation, not a seasonal crop. Broad FAO climate ranges are only a first screen; soil depth, drainage, elevation, planting material, and years before tapping matter. The weather window is not time to first harvest.

name: Oil palm
thai: ปาล์มน้ำมัน
notes: A long-term tree crop, not a one-season harvest. Broad FAO climate ranges are only a first screen; drainage, soil, water through establishment, seedlings, and years before harvest matter.

name: Durian
notes: A long-term fruit tree, not a seasonal crop. Broad FAO climate ranges are only a first screen; soil drainage, dry-season water, variety, slope, and years before harvest matter.
